Material Plane.effects: Standard 5e physics and environmental laws apply.

Feywild.effects: Time Dilation is active (1 day inside could be 1 year or 1 hour in the Material Plane). Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. Spellcasters have a 10% chance of triggering wild magic surges on leveled spells.

Shadowfell.effects: Disadvantage on all death saving throws. Disheartening gloom: any short rest requires a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or the creature gains no benefit from the rest.

Astral Plane.effects: No aging, no need for food or water. Intelligence score replaces Strength score for physical speed and jump distance calculations.

Elemental Plane of Fire.effects: Fire resistance becomes normal fire damage (resistance bypassed). Unprotected creatures take 1d10 fire damage at the start of every round of combat. Extreme heat triggers exhaustion rules.

Nine Hells.effects: Fiends have advantage on all saving throws. Creatures of good alignment must make a DC 12 Charisma saving throw each dawn or have disadvantage on all checks until the next dawn.
